assertions.subject: Antipsychotic-Induced Parkinsonism
assertions.quote: About 80% of individuals taking typical antipsychotics experience extrapyramidal symptoms

assertions.subject: Antipsychotic-Induced Parkinsonism
assertions.quote: High-potency drugs such as fluphenazine, haloperidol, and trifluoperazine are frequently associated with drug-induced parkinsonism

assertions.subject: Antipsychotic-Induced Parkinsonism
assertions.quote: Low-potency drugs such as chlorpromazine and thioridazine are also known causes but are less common

assertions.subject: Antipsychotic-Induced Parkinsonism
assertions.quote: These drugs are also known as atypical antipsychotics, and they generally pose a lower risk compared to first-generation antipsychotics
